Chain rule: after a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose FIRST item is B. Start at ppy: the pair (ppy, bvx) comes first; its second item is bvx, so the next pair is the one whose first item is bvx: (bvx, vvx). Its second item is vvx, but vvx never appears as a first item - so vvx is the dangling end of the chain.
